experiment: MED008 Gate1: coded original note segments (paired to existing MED005 ranking+replay baseline)
baseline: MED005_RANK_REPLAY_LoRA (same optimizer schedule, without note objective)
limitations: Raw note segments are learned exactly from original case notes, not newly generated factual QA.
Frozen QA question and answer never enter optimization, but answers MAY be contained in original patient notes by design.
This tests untrained QA wording on known patient facts, not genuinely unseen patient facts.
The eight heldout QA have been examined in earlier pilots; exploratory only.
An explicit note-segment index can help memorize text but need not transfer to natural QA.
